title: The Midnight Edition

setting.summary: The Vesper Chronicle Newsroom and North Gate Lithograph & Print Shop during deadline rush.

briefing: At 23:30, the midnight edition of The Vesper Chronicle appeared with a forged front-page headline suppressing a city corruption investigation. Who substituted the lead slug on the rotary press, and how was their false verification exposed?

characters.name: Quinn Harper
characters.publicDescription: Author of the municipal corruption report; was conducting archive research during deadline.

characters.name: Roland Finch
characters.publicDescription: Veteran pressman responsible for freight dock deliveries and mechanical press maintenance.

characters.name: Silas Thorne
characters.publicDescription: Editor-in-chief overseeing editorial sign-off and safe custody of master headline slugs.

characters.name: Toby Crane
characters.publicDescription: Composing room assistant assigned to verify plate mounting before the print run.

locations.name: The Vesper Chronicle Newsroom
locations.description: Editorial offices, reference library, and secured archive vault in downtown Vesper City.

locations.name: North Gate Lithograph & Print Shop
locations.description: Industrial printing facility containing heavy rotary presses, casting furnaces, and composing bays.

objects.name: The High-Speed Rotary Press
objects.description: Heavy industrial printing press fitted with optical plate alignment sensors.

objects.name: The Front-Page Headline Slug
objects.description: A cast lead typography slug bearing the approved editorial headline for the midnight edition.

clues.text: Quinn stated: 'I remained in the newsroom archives from 23:05 to 23:25 reviewing municipal land deeds.'
Roland stated: 'I was monitoring loading dock deliveries from 23:05 to 23:25.'
Toby stated: 'I inspected the rotary press plate at 23:15 in the print shop, and its verification status was approved_original.'
Managing editor custody log: Silas Thorne held verified custody of the Front-Page Headline Slug in the newsroom from 23:00 to 23:15.
Print shop delivery reader: Master Typesetter Roland Finch scanned security key at Loading Dock at 23:08.
Newsroom electronic door lock: Quinn Harper badged into Archives Vault at 23:10.
Rotary press optical scanner telemetry: Press cylinder plate status registered as forged_altered at 23:15.
Composing bay camera recording: Toby Crane observed inside North Gate Print Shop from 23:15 to 23:30.

hypotheses.label: Quinn Harper altered the headline plate in the composing room to fabricate a sensational scoop.
Roland Finch smuggled the forged slug in early and held exclusive possession of the plate.
Toby Crane substituted the headline plate on the rotary press in the composing bay.

explanation.text: Quinn Harper entered the newsroom archive vault at 23:10, disproving allegations that she was at the print shop across town.
Silas Thorne held exclusive custody of the master headline slug until 23:15, disproving that Roland Finch smuggled it earlier.
Rotary press optical sensors confirmed the plate status was forged_altered at 23:15, directly contradicting Toby Crane's claim of an approved plate.
Toby Crane mounted the counterfeit plate onto the rotary press at 23:20, confirming him as the sole perpetrator.
